encryption.algorithm: RC4-128 (PDF standard security handler V2 R3)

dependencies: pypdf 6.18.1 (in .venv-qa) - RC4 only, no cryptography wheels needed

provenance.authorship: written by the project team for this spike (ds2); one blank page plus a literal ASCII string, then encrypted by pypdf
provenance.source_documents: none - content is the literal ASCII string PDF4All encrypted

verified_with: mupdf 1.28.1 JS: needsPassword() true, getMetaData('encryption') = 'Standard V2 R3 128-bit RC4', countPages() = 1
purpose: P1 detection path: an encrypted document must be reported as encrypted/needsPassword and never rendered; the generator also writes encrypted-noprint.pdf (same script, print permission cleared)
